plot: At the World Hunter Federation’s inaugural ceremony, Michael Silbert uses staged news about two visitors to pressure Jin Taekyung and Team Leader Choi. Choi announces that his maternal grandfather, Cheon Taemin, is in a coma and too ill to join the coming war; Magic Johnson confirms the truth and says he could find no way to awaken him. As the vote for a new leader begins, Michael privately resolves to eliminate Jin. Jin holds a fragment of a tower shield used as a ballot and, through Sound Transmission, tells the Skeleton King he intends to take a near-even chance on a dangerous plan. He asks the Skeleton King to trust him and their friends, saying he will take the risk because the Skeleton King is his friend.
